verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Spend AI runs built-in automations in the background: it captures and matches receipts without manual input and applies user-defined spend rules through always-on checks. These are fixed, vendor-defined AI workflows within spend management, not a general facility for users to build their own autonomous automations. APIs, SDKs, webhooks and recurring payments are developer building blocks or adjacent billing features, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: user-configurable general automation/workflow builder, documented triggers and schedules for custom background jobs, autonomous agent actions beyond expense/receipt processing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Always-on checks to audit reports and apply your spend rules automatically, without slowing employees down.
AI captures receipts and matches them to the right card transactions without manual input from employees.
Purchase orders automatically linked to bills and line items, giving you real-time visibility. No manual reconciliation required.
